roadmap.title: Before the casino
roadmap.description: Answer the launch prompt, open the support page and climb the plaza parkour course.

roadmap.title: Floor 1 (Days 1-3)
roadmap.description: Finish the Floor 1 challenges before Day 4 opens Floor 2.

roadmap.title: Floor 2 (Days 4-6)
roadmap.description: Finish the Floor 2 challenges before Day 7 opens Floor 3.

roadmap.title: Floor 3 (Days 7-9)
roadmap.description: Finish the Floor 3 challenges before Day 10 opens Floor 4.

roadmap.title: Floor 4 and money (Days 10-12)
roadmap.description: Finish the Floor 4 challenges and build up your earnings.

roadmap.title: Day 13 endings
roadmap.description: Pick the Day 13 outcomes, reloading between them.

achievements.description: Win the coin flip on Day 13.
achievements.summary: On Day 13, pick Double or Nothing and have the coin land on heads.

guide.context: To get both coin flip endings in one save, quit the moment the achievement pops, reload, and reroll the shop behind the Misfortune van before the limo.

steps.text: On Day 13, pick the left option, Double or Nothing.
Heads (green) doubles your money and unlocks it.

achievements.description: Lose the coin flip on Day 13.
achievements.summary: On Day 13, pick Double or Nothing and have the coin land on tails.

guide.context: If the coin keeps landing on heads, reload and reroll the shop behind the Misfortune van before the limo. If one reroll gives the wrong result, try two.

steps.text: On Day 13, pick the left option, Double or Nothing.
Tails (red) loses everything and unlocks it.

achievements.description: Pay off your debt on Day 13.
achievements.summary: Pay off your debt on Day 13.

guide.context: If you already took the coin flip endings, quit as the second achievement pops, reload, and pay the debt this time.

steps.text: On Day 13, choose Pay off your debt (the right option).

achievements.description: Spend a lot of money on Floor 1.
achievements.summary: Spend the large amount your Floor 1 challenge shows.

guide.context: Games with good odds for the player, such as Roulette and Street Craps, lose less.

steps.text: Take the Floor 1 challenge from the phone booth (rerolling costs 1 ticket).
Place bets until you have spent the challenge amount.

achievements.description: Win 4 games in a row on Blackjack on Floor 1.
achievements.summary: Win 4 Blackjack games in a row.

guide.context: Blackjack uses one unshuffled deck, so reloading the day gives the same cards. Use that to learn the order.

steps.text: Take the Floor 1 challenge from the phone booth (rerolling costs 1 ticket).
Play Blackjack until you win 4 games in a row.

achievements.description: Get 7 on your first roll on Street Craps on Floor 1.
achievements.summary: Make your opening Street Craps roll add up to 7.

guide.context: Street Craps is a physics game, so reloading does not repeat the roll.

steps.text: Take the Floor 1 challenge from the phone booth (rerolling costs 1 ticket).
Bet the minimum on Street Craps and roll. A first-roll total of 7 unlocks it.
To improve the odds, bring a bat from the lobby or the back of Floor 1. Roll the first die, then hit the second die with the bat before it stops so the total is 7.

achievements.description: Place a very big bet on Floor 1.
achievements.summary: Place one very large bet, using the amount your Floor 1 challenge shows.

guide.context: Winning the bet is not required.

steps.text: Take the Floor 1 challenge from the phone booth (rerolling costs 1 ticket).
Place one bet of the amount the challenge shows.

achievements.description: Win 3 games in a row on Floor 1.
achievements.summary: Win three separate games back to back on Floor 1.

guide.context: Games with good odds for the player, such as Roulette and Street Craps, are the safest picks.

steps.text: Take the Floor 1 challenge from the phone booth (rerolling costs 1 ticket).
Play games until you win three back to back.

achievements.description: Bet a lot of money on Roulette on Floor 1.
achievements.summary: Bet the large amount your Floor 1 challenge shows on Roulette.

guide.context: Roulette results repeat when you reload the day, so you can retry a lost round.

steps.text: Take the Floor 1 challenge from the phone booth (rerolling costs 1 ticket).
Bet the challenge amount on Roulette and win the round.

achievements.description: Win with 10X on Slot Machine on Floor 1.
achievements.summary: Win a 10X payout on a slot machine.

guide.context: The 10X payout is rare. Betting the minimum on all four slot machines gives the most spins.

steps.text: Take the Floor 1 challenge from the phone booth (rerolling costs 1 ticket).
Bet the minimum on the slot machines and spin until one pays 10X.

achievements.description: Win on Blackjack with a hand value less than 10 on Floor 1.
achievements.summary: Win a Blackjack hand with a total below 10.

guide.context: Blackjack uses one unshuffled deck, so the same cards return when you reload the day.

steps.text: Take the Floor 1 challenge from the phone booth (rerolling costs 1 ticket).
Win a Blackjack hand while your total is below 10.
If it does not unlock, reload the day and try again.

achievements.description: Bet on YARL and win on Duck Race on Floor 1.
achievements.summary: Win a Duck Race after betting on the duck named YARL.

steps.text: Take the Floor 1 challenge from the phone booth (rerolling costs 1 ticket).
Bet on the duck named YARL in Duck Race and win the race.

achievements.description: Win 3 games by betting a lot of money on Wheel of Fortune on Floor 1.
achievements.summary: Win 3 Wheel of Fortune games after betting the large amount your Floor 1 challenge shows.

guide.context: A spin counts as a win only at 2x or higher.

steps.text: Take the Floor 1 challenge from the phone booth (rerolling costs 1 ticket).
Bet the challenge amount on Wheel of Fortune and win 3 games with a 2x or higher result.

achievements.description: Spend a lot of money on Floor 2.
achievements.summary: Spend the large amount your Floor 2 challenge shows.

steps.text: Take the Floor 2 challenge from the phone booth (rerolling costs 1 ticket).
Place bets until you have spent the challenge amount.

achievements.description: Win at least 10X on Crash on Floor 2.
achievements.summary: Win at least 10X on Crash.

steps.text: Take the Floor 2 challenge from the phone booth (rerolling costs 1 ticket).
Bet the minimum on Crash and cash out only at 10X or higher.

achievements.description: Win at least "3X" 2 times in a row on Penguin Cross on Floor 2.
achievements.summary: Win at least 3X twice in a row on Penguin Cross.

steps.text: Take the Floor 2 challenge from the phone booth (rerolling costs 1 ticket).
Play Penguin Cross and cash out at 3X or higher. Do it again in the next game.

achievements.description: Profit a lot of money on HiLo on Floor 2.
achievements.summary: Win the large profit your Floor 2 challenge shows on HiLo.

guide.context: If a try fails, reload the day or try again the next day.

steps.text: Take the Floor 2 challenge from the phone booth (rerolling costs 1 ticket).
Set the HiLo slider to a 5x to 10x payout and play until your profit reaches the challenge amount.

achievements.description: Place a very big bet on Floor 2.
achievements.summary: Place one very large bet, using the amount your Floor 2 challenge shows.

guide.context: The amount is higher than on Floor 1. Winning is not required.

steps.text: Take the Floor 2 challenge from the phone booth (rerolling costs 1 ticket).
Place one bet of the amount the challenge shows.

achievements.description: Bet a lot of money on Keno on Floor 2.
achievements.summary: Bet the large amount your Floor 2 challenge shows on Keno.

guide.context: Keno draws repeat when you reload the day.

steps.text: Take the Floor 2 challenge from the phone booth (rerolling costs 1 ticket).
Place a Keno bet of the amount the challenge shows.

achievements.description: Win 4 games in a row on Floor 2.
achievements.summary: Win four separate games back to back on Floor 2.

guide.context: Roulette, Plinko, Street Craps and HiLo are recommended.

steps.text: Take the Floor 2 challenge from the phone booth (rerolling costs 1 ticket).
Play games until you win four back to back.

achievements.description: Win 3 games in a row with a lot of money on Money Wheel on Floor 2.
achievements.summary: Win 3 Money Wheel games in a row, betting the large amount your Floor 2 challenge shows each time.

guide.context: Betting on the 2x wedge has the best odds.

steps.text: Take the Floor 2 challenge from the phone booth (rerolling costs 1 ticket).
Bet the challenge amount on the 2x wedge of Money Wheel and win 3 games in a row.

achievements.description: Win 24X on Plinko on Floor 2.
achievements.summary: Win 24X on Plinko.

guide.context: Plinko is a physics game. Bats placed in the board can steer the ball to 24X.

steps.text: Take the Floor 2 challenge from the phone booth (rerolling costs 1 ticket).
Take a bat from the lobby into the elevator and ride to Floor 2. Pick up the second bat on Floor 2, left of the elevator.
Put both bats in front of Plinko. Climb onto the machine and throw one bat into the board at the second row from the top.
Stand behind the machine, point at the gap between the two 0.2 payouts, and throw the second bat in.
Bet the minimum on Plinko until a ball lands on 24X.

achievements.description: Don't lock cards and win with a hand equal to or better than Two of a Kind on 1P Poker on Floor 3.
achievements.summary: Win a 1P Poker hand of Two of a Kind or better without locking any cards.

steps.text: Take the Floor 3 challenge from the phone booth (rerolling costs 1 ticket).
Play 1P Poker without locking any card until you win with Two of a Kind or better.

achievements.description: Bet a lot of money across all games on Floor 3.
achievements.summary: Bet the large amount your Floor 3 challenge shows across all games.

steps.text: Take the Floor 3 challenge from the phone booth (rerolling costs 1 ticket).
Place bets on any games until the total reaches the challenge amount.

achievements.description: Win on Street Craps during the point phase on Floor 3.
achievements.summary: Win a Street Craps round during the point phase.

guide.context: The point phase starts when the first roll is 4, 5, 6, 8, 9 or 10. You win by rolling that number again. A bat can nudge the second die, as in the Floor 1 Lucky 7 method.

steps.text: Take the Floor 3 challenge from the phone booth (rerolling costs 1 ticket).
Bet on Street Craps. If the first roll is 4, 5, 6, 8, 9 or 10, you are in the point phase.
Keep rolling until that number comes up again, within 3 turns.

achievements.description: Win at least 4X on Penguin Cross on Floor 3.
achievements.summary: Cash out of a Penguin Cross game at a 4X multiplier or better.

steps.text: Take the Floor 3 challenge from the phone booth (rerolling costs 1 ticket).
Play Penguin Cross and cash out once the multiplier reaches at least 4X.

achievements.description: Win 10x on HiLo on Floor 3.
achievements.summary: Win 10x on HiLo.

steps.text: Take the Floor 3 challenge from the phone booth (rerolling costs 1 ticket).
Play HiLo with the slider set for a 10x payout until a round wins.

achievements.description: Lose 4 times in a row on Dragon Tower on Floor 3.
achievements.summary: Lose four Dragon Tower games back to back.

guide.context: Climbing higher in the tower makes a loss more likely.

steps.text: Take the Floor 3 challenge from the phone booth (rerolling costs 1 ticket).
Play Dragon Tower and keep climbing in one column.
Repeat until you have lost four rounds back to back.

achievements.description: Place a very big bet on Floor 3.
achievements.summary: Place one very large bet, using the amount your Floor 3 challenge shows.

guide.context: Winning is not required.

steps.text: Take the Floor 3 challenge from the phone booth (rerolling costs 1 ticket).
Place one bet of the amount the challenge shows.

achievements.description: Win 5 games in a row on Floor 3.
achievements.summary: Win five separate games back to back on Floor 3.

steps.text: Take the Floor 3 challenge from the phone booth (rerolling costs 1 ticket).
Play games that favor the player until you win five back to back.

achievements.description: Win at least 20X on Mine Sweeper on Floor 3.
achievements.summary: Win at least 20X on Minesweeper.

guide.context: Picking the most mines makes 20X come faster. Layouts repeat when you reload the day.

steps.text: Take the Floor 3 challenge from the phone booth (rerolling costs 1 ticket).
Pick the highest number of mines on Minesweeper and open tiles until your payout reaches 20X.

achievements.description: Spend a lot of money on Wheel of Fortune on Floor 3.
achievements.summary: Spend the large amount your Floor 3 challenge shows on Wheel of Fortune.

steps.text: Take the Floor 3 challenge from the phone booth (rerolling costs 1 ticket).
Bet on Wheel of Fortune until you have spent the challenge amount.

achievements.description: Bet a lot of money across all games on Floor 4.
achievements.summary: Bet the large amount your Floor 4 challenge shows across all games.

steps.text: Take the Floor 4 challenge from the phone booth (rerolling costs 1 ticket).
Place bets on any games until the total reaches the challenge amount.

achievements.description: Win a lot of money on Blackjack on Floor 4.
achievements.summary: Win the large amount your Floor 4 challenge shows on Blackjack.

steps.text: Take the Floor 4 challenge from the phone booth (rerolling costs 1 ticket).
Go all-in on Blackjack until you win the challenge amount.
If you bust, reload the day and try again.

achievements.description: Win 4 times in a row on Crash on Floor 4.
achievements.summary: Win four Crash games back to back.

guide.context: Cashing out at 1.01x counts as a win and keeps the streak.

steps.text: Take the Floor 4 challenge from the phone booth (rerolling costs 1 ticket).
Play Crash and cash out at 1.01x each game, 4 games in a row.

achievements.description: Spend a lot of money on Penguin Cross on Floor 4.
achievements.summary: Spend the large amount your Floor 4 challenge shows on Penguin Cross.

steps.text: Take the Floor 4 challenge from the phone booth (rerolling costs 1 ticket).
Bet on Penguin Cross until you have spent the challenge amount.

achievements.description: Win at least "3x" 3 times in a row on Dragon Tower on Floor 4.
achievements.summary: Win Dragon Tower at 3x or better, three games back to back.

steps.text: Take the Floor 4 challenge from the phone booth (rerolling costs 1 ticket).
Play Dragon Tower and cash out after climbing 4 tiles. Do it 3 games in a row.

achievements.description: Win 2 games in a row on Duck Race on Floor 4.
achievements.summary: Win 2 Duck Races in a row.

steps.text: Take the Floor 4 challenge from the phone booth (rerolling costs 1 ticket).
Bet on a Duck Race until you win 2 in a row.

achievements.description: Place a very big bet on Floor 4.
achievements.summary: Place one very large bet, using the amount your Floor 4 challenge shows.

guide.context: Winning is not required.

steps.text: Take the Floor 4 challenge from the phone booth (rerolling costs 1 ticket).
Place one bet of the amount the challenge shows.

achievements.description: Profit a lot of money on Keno on Floor 4.
achievements.summary: Profit the large amount your Floor 4 challenge shows on Keno.

guide.context: Keno draws repeat after you reload the day.

steps.text: Take the Floor 4 challenge from the phone booth (rerolling costs 1 ticket).
Play Keno until your profit reaches the challenge amount. Reload the day after a bad run.

achievements.description: Win 5 games in a row on Floor 4.
achievements.summary: Win five separate games back to back on Floor 4.

steps.text: Take the Floor 4 challenge from the phone booth (rerolling costs 1 ticket).
Play games until you win five back to back.

achievements.description: Win "5X" 3 times in a row on Mine Sweeper on Floor 4.
achievements.summary: Win 5X three times in a row on Minesweeper.

guide.context: Minesweeper layouts repeat when you reload the day, so you can learn the safe tiles first.

steps.text: Take the Floor 4 challenge from the phone booth (rerolling costs 1 ticket).
On Minesweeper, choose 10 mines, bet the minimum and open the 3 tiles at the bottom left.
Repeat until you win 5X three games in a row. Or learn the safe tiles on a first try, quit to the menu, reload, and use them.

achievements.description: Lose 5 games in a row on Money Wheel on Floor 4.
achievements.summary: Lose 5 Money Wheel games in a row.

steps.text: Take the Floor 4 challenge from the phone booth (rerolling costs 1 ticket).
Play Money Wheel until you lose 5 games in a row.

achievements.description: Lose 7 games in a row on Plinko on Floor 4.
achievements.summary: Lose 7 Plinko games in a row.

guide.context: Plinko is a physics game. Two bats can steer the ball into low payouts.

steps.text: Take the Floor 4 challenge from the phone booth (rerolling costs 1 ticket).
Carry 2 bats in the elevator to Floor 4, or they disappear.
At the Plinko machine, aim inside a 1.2x multiplier and throw a bat so it stays there. Do the same with the other 1.2x.
Bet the minimum until you lose 7 games in a row.

achievements.description: Spend a lot of money on Roulette on Floor 4.
achievements.summary: Spend the large amount your Floor 4 challenge shows on Roulette.

steps.text: Take the Floor 4 challenge from the phone booth (rerolling costs 1 ticket).
Bet on Roulette until you have spent the challenge amount.

achievements.description: Collect $10M.
achievements.summary: Earn $10M in a single save.

steps.text: Keep gambling and winning above the daily quota until your earnings in this save reach $10M.

achievements.description: Collect $100M.
achievements.summary: Earn $100M in a single save.

steps.text: Keep gambling and winning above the daily quota until your earnings in this save reach $100M.

achievements.description: Collect $1B.
achievements.summary: Earn $1B in a single save.

steps.text: Keep gambling and winning above the daily quota until your earnings in this save reach $1B.

achievements.description: Collect $10B.
achievements.summary: Earn $10B in a single save.

guide.context: Meeting the daily quota is not enough; play above it.

steps.text: Keep gambling and winning above the daily quota until your earnings in this save reach $10B.

achievements.description: Collect $100B.
achievements.summary: Earn $100B in a single save.

guide.context: Meeting the daily quota is not enough; play above it.

steps.text: Keep gambling and winning above the daily quota until your earnings in this save reach $100B.

achievements.description: Answer NO to the prompt shown when the game launches.
achievements.summary: Choose NO at the start-up luck prompt.

steps.text: Start the game and choose NO at the lucky prompt.

achievements.description: Win the coin flip on the launch prompt.
achievements.summary: Choose YES at the start-up luck prompt and win the coin toss.

steps.text: Start the game and choose YES at the lucky prompt.
If the coin lands on green (heads), the achievement unlocks. If it lands on red, relaunch and try again.

achievements.description: Lose the coin flip on the launch prompt.
achievements.summary: Choose YES at the start-up luck prompt and lose the coin toss.

steps.text: Start the game and choose YES at the lucky prompt.
If the coin lands on red, the achievement unlocks and the game closes. If it lands on green, relaunch and try again.

achievements.description: Reach the top of the obstacle course at the starting plaza.
achievements.summary: Reach the top platform of the parkour course at the starting plaza.

steps.text: From the spawn area at Tenwick Plaza, go to the parkour course beside the black Misfortune van.
Climb to the top platform, where the BANG BANG figure sits.

achievements.description: Check out the Gambling Support Services around the world and educate yourself.
achievements.summary: Open the Gambling Support Services page from the main menu.

steps.text: On the main menu, select "Get Help (Gamble Hotline)".
